title: Today’s feel: head pressure creeping in.
caption: Today’s feel: head pressure creeping in. Signals look mostly steady with a small wobble, so bright rooms and long screens may press on that snug cap. Take short screen breaks, lower the light, sip water with a small salty snack, and keep tasks small with slow-breath pauses.
snapshot: Geomagnetic conditions are quiet overall, with a mild unsettled undertone. Solar wind is in a typical range and no new flares were reported. The magnetic field has leaned southward at times. A couple of CMEs were observed recently, with no sign they’re aimed at us.
affects: Head pressure or a tight, full feeling can be more noticeable today, especially in bright rooms or during long screen time. Some may also feel more reactive to noise and quick posture changes. These shifts tend to come in waves rather than all day, so short breathers can help keep symptoms from stacking.
playbook:
- Use short screen breaks and dimmer brightness
- Sip water and add a light, salty snack if needed
- Step outside for a minute of cooler air or shade
- Gentle neck and jaw relax, then slow breathing
- Keep tasks small and give yourself buffer time
